title: Recent Patterns in Scams Targeting Seniors
what_it_is: Recent Patterns in Scams Targeting Seniors

sections.label: Seniors as scam victims
sections.summary: In 2025 seniors aged 65 and above were about 15% of scam victims, the only age group to rise, losing about $37,000 each on average.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2025, seniors aged 65 and above made up about 15% of all scam victims, the only age group to register an increase in the number of victims between 2024 and 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Each senior lost about $37,000 on average, the highest among all age groups.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: About two in five scam victims who are seniors fell prey to investment or government official impersonation scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police do not track the amount of scam proceeds recovered by age group.

sections.label: Police asset recovery measures
sections.summary: The Police have implemented measures to improve asset recovery, including stronger international law enforcement collaboration and enhanced cryptocurrency tracing capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding, the Police have implemented several measures to improve asset recovery, including strengthening international collaboration among law enforcement agencies and enhancing cryptocurrency tracing capabilities.

sections.label: Global scam losses report
sections.summary: One report states that last year more than US$440 billion were lost to scams globally.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: One report has it that last year, more than US$440 billion were lost to scams globally.

sections.label: Scam proceeds recovered tracked
sections.summary: The Police do track scam proceeds recovered, and the amount recovered is a small proportion of the monies lost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, the Police do track the amount of scam proceeds recovered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Yes, the amount of scam proceeds that have been recovered are a small proportion compared to the overall amount of monies that is lost.
